title: Canonical nested slice map induces stalk isomorphisms
statement: For a sheaf F on X and opens V ⊆ U, the canonical direct-sum presheaf map P_V → P_U obtained by composing indices with V → U induces an isomorphism on the stalk at every point of V.

proof.text: Use the cofinal system of neighborhoods contained in V. On each such neighborhood both indexing types are subsingletons, so the canonical component is an isomorphism. The germ presentation of stalks transfers these local isomorphisms to the stalk map, proving both surjectivity and injectivity.
